releaseNotes:
• A simpler floating pill in Liquid Glass, so it follows System Settings ▸ Appearance: a red dot, the level and your words, nothing else. It shows up as soon as you press, and says plainly when no microphone is connected.
• Your microphone on Home: see it and switch it, kept current as headsets come and go. Bluetooth headsets that reconfigure when the mic opens no longer cut a recording short.
• One update button: Download & Install — the app reopens on Home when it's done.
• Simpler Settings: fewer options, less to read.
